300blk is underpowered. People seem to like it for AR pistol builds because the powder used in 300blk is pistol powder, which burns off a little bit faster, which, on paper, makes sense with a short barrel. The problem is however, this also makes the round underpowered, so your muzzle velocity, accuracy, and effective range will suffer. In my opinion, as long as the barrel is at least 10 inches long, just go with 5.56. Also, last I checked, the cost of 300blk ammo tends to be higher than 5.56, as well as less readily available. And it weighs more.

If you want to do an AR pistol build, and use a larger diameter bullet than 5.56, and want to keep weight down, and don't mind the lower muzzle velocity or reduced accuracy or range, then I would suggest building a 9mm, 45acp, or 10mm AR pistol. It used to be that you would have to buy a special lower, custom built for the appropriate size magazines, but now you can actually buy an insert that fits in a standard AR magwell, and receives, I believe, Glock magazines.
My pleasure. Feel free to pm me any questions you may have about your upcoming build.
